name: Dai Doan Ket Square
summary: Dai Doan Ket Square is Pleiku’s outdoor stage for gong culture. The 2026 festival announces Gong Festival Night here at 20:00 on 7 November, and the Ministry of Culture promotes Saturday-evening gong enjoyment at this square and Nguyen Tat Thanh Square. Start times outside festival week are check on arrival.
